Generate all required React TypeScript files as JSON:

{
        "files": [
          { "path": "app/home/page.tsx", "content": "..." },
          { "path": "components/card.tsx", "content": "..." },
          { "path": "components/input.tsx", "content": "..." }
        ]
  }

Jira description:
You are generating a full screen using the Broker App White Label design system.
You MUST adhere to the Figma metadata and PNG reference located at:

You MUST follow the design exactly — spacing, typography, radii, colors, and layout.

----

h2. *RULES*

h3. *1. Output files*

/components/card.tsx

You must output *exactly* the following files:

h3. *2. page.tsx*

This file MUST:

* 
* Use only components defined above
* Match layout of the PNG and Figma structure
* Follow spacing tokens
* 

h3. *3. Component rules*

Each component must:

* Be standalone
* Use TailwindCSS (latest version)
* Follow the tokens from metadata
* Use existing primitives if available
* Match the exact design in the provided PNG

h3. *4. Absolutely NO deviations*

The model may NOT:

* Add new buttons
* Add blue Confirm/Cancel buttons
* Change layout
* Change colors
* Change spacing
* Replace the bottom nav with something else
* Replace KPI cards with generic cards
* Replace the header style

h3. *5. Accessibility*

* All interactive elements must have ARIA labels
* TabBar must follow accessible nav patterns
* Cards with actions require {{role=button}}
